### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> SpaceX plans ambitious South Texas launch for Monday
SpaceX is launching Starship 14 on Monday, September 28 from South Texas, marking the first Starship flight to fully deploy operational Starlink satellites. The rocket is expected to reach approximately 170 miles altitude and complete six orbits over 10 hours pending FAA approval.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Launch: Monday, September 28, 7:15–8:30 a.m. from Starbase, South Texas</li>
<li>Starship 14: tallest and most powerful rocket ever built</li>
<li>First flight to fully deploy operational Starlink satellites into space</li>
<li>Expected altitude: ~170 miles; six orbits over 10 hours</li>
<li>Booster and upper stage separate ~2.5 minutes after launch</li>
</ul>
